description: removes ECG/EMG/face channels, downsample at 250Hz, removes line noise, filters and cleans the data, interpolates bad channels, restores the reference channel order, and applies average referencing. ses ICA/ICLabel to remove eye and muscle components, then rejects remaining bad segments with ASR.
baseline-corrected, event-locked task epochs, or 2-second resting-state epochs with 25% overlap.
summary of preprocessing pipeline, including removed channels and epoch count.

LDAEP features: per-channel, per-intensity N1/P2 latency and amplitude (from a subject-specific grand-average-derived window), the N1-P2 point slope per intensity, and a per-channel linear regression of N1-P2 amplitude against stimulus intensity (offset, slope, RMSE). Oddball features: P3 features from the oddball task (DIN2 target events): per-channel latency, amplitude, zero-crossing latency, and area under the curve, using a subject-specific grand-average window derived from a posterior (Pz-anchored) channel ROI. DIN1 (standard) rows reuse the DIN2-derived latencies rather than independent peak detection, for direct within-channel comparison. Rest(EO/EC) features:  Resting-state band power (theta, alpha, beta, gamma) per channel via the EEGSTATS plugin (pop_eegstats), following COBIDAS MEEG frequency band conventions. Group-level QC values are averaged over fixed fronto-central/occipito-parietal/central channel sets (theta/alpha/beta), or the median across all channels (gamma).

per-channel and subject-level (median) aperiodic offset, exponent, and model R-squared from resting-state EEG, fit using the Python FOOOF library (fooof-tools/fooof) via MATLAB's pyrun on a per-channel Welch power spectrum. Offset reflects overall broadband power; exponent reflects the steepness of the 1/f spectral slope (linked to excitatory/inhibitory balance in the literature); R-squared indicates model fit quality. Computed by eeg_rest_fooof.m from desc-epoched_eeg data.
